task_title: 전체 3D epsilon/VJP를 만들지 않는 geometry/density slab 생성·gradient 축약 경로를 공개 합성 구조로 시험한다

physics_configuration.region: 3D, 800 x 32 x 32 cells at 0.05 um (40 x 1.6 x 1.6 um), 4 CPML cells (geometry: on every face; density: periodic x and y, CPML z), Yee sampling, FP32, 10 steps, memory_mode streamed
physics_configuration.geometry: public synthetic solids of torchfdtd.streamed_geometry: a box 0.9 x 0.9 x 0.5 um rotated 20 degrees about z with epsilon p0 = 3.1 and centre (p1, 0, 0) = (0.1, 0, 0) um, and a sphere of radius p2 = 0.4 um, epsilon 2.4, at (-0.6, 0.2, 0.1) um; background 1; chunk_cells 65536; three differentiable parameters
physics_configuration.density: 16 x 8 periodic density layer (torchfdtd.streamed_density_layer) between z = -0.2 and 0.2 um, background epsilon 1, design epsilon 4, cell-edge pixel origin, values from torch.rand with seed 3; 128 differentiable parameters
physics_configuration.source_and_monitor: Ez point source at (0, 0, -0.1) um, standard Gaussian pulse (0.8 um, FWHM 0.5 fs, centre 0.5 fs, amplitude 100); one Ez probe at (0, 0, 0.1) um; objective sum of squared time signals
physics_configuration.policy: StreamedAdjointOptions(device=cuda, slab_width=8, temporal_depth=5, checkpoints=0, gpu_budget_bytes=9600000, host_budget_bytes=8 GiB, state_storage=disk (private scratch, disk_budget_bytes 2 GiB), tile_transfers=sync)
physics_configuration.full_epsilon: the diagonal Yee-sampled FP32 material of the whole grid: 800*32*32*3*4 = 9,830,400 bytes, larger than the declared GPU budget of 9,600,000 bytes, so a path that materialized it on the device could not be admitted or would exceed its budget
physics_configuration.instruments: report['forward_memory'] and report['backward_memory'] peak_torch_allocated_bytes.delta_bytes (exact allocator peak after torch.cuda.reset_peak_memory_stats), the AllocationTrace TorchDispatchMode of tests/test_streamed_geometry.py listing every host tensor allocation with its shape and storage bytes (disk banks keep the field state out of host tensors), report['dense_material_storage_bytes'], report['dense_material_vjp_bytes'], report['design_tensor_bytes'], report['optimizer_state_reservation_bytes']
physics_configuration.budget_checks: torchfdtd/streamed.py::_reservation adds optimizer_moments * design_tensor_bytes to the host reservation for the dense, dispersive, geometry and density paths; estimate_streamed_memory, plan_streamed_work and the run report carry the same fields; Adam's exp_avg and exp_avg_sq of a leaf of the geometry packet's shape are compared with the declared two moments

reference_method: a size bound, not a physics oracle: the byte size of the full diagonal epsilon array computed from the grid shape, and the parameter tensor sizes computed from their shapes; the design-slab physics itself is verified against the dense material in tests/test_streamed_geometry.py and tests/test_streamed_density.py

observables.name: peak_torch_allocated_delta_bytes
observables.definition: max over the forward and backward phases of the exact Torch allocator peak minus the bytes allocated when the phase began

observables.name: full_shape_host_allocations
observables.definition: host tensor allocations with shape (800,32,32), (800,32,32,3) or (800,32,32,1) and storage above 4 bytes during the run and its backward

observables.name: max_host_allocation_bytes
observables.definition: largest host tensor storage allocated during the run

observables.name: gradient_max_abs
observables.definition: largest gradient magnitude of the design parameters, which must be finite and nonzero so that the VJP path really ran

acceptance_limits.device_rule: for both paths the exact peak Torch allocated delta is below full_epsilon_bytes and at most gpu_budget_bytes, and gpu_reservation_bytes is at most gpu_budget_bytes
acceptance_limits.host_rule: full_shape_host_allocations == 0; dense_material_storage_bytes == 0 and dense_material_vjp_bytes == 0 in the report; the gradient is finite and nonzero
acceptance_limits.budget_rule: for the dense path (_reservation, estimate_streamed_memory, plan_streamed_work, the run report) and the geometry and density executions, host_reservation_bytes with optimizer_moments = k minus host_reservation_bytes with 0 moments equals exactly k * design_tensor_bytes for k in {1, 2}, gpu_reservation_bytes is unchanged, design_tensor_bytes equals the parameter tensor's numel times element size, the dense parameter reservation is an integer multiple (at least one) of it, a budget equal to the moment-free reservation refuses the run with moments, and the declared two moments equal the byte size of Adam's two state tensors
acceptance_limits.source_of_limits: G5-04 specification: no full 3D epsilon/VJP in the geometry/density slab paths, the CPU design tensor and optimizer state reflected in the memory budget; the size bound is the array size itself and no numeric tolerance applies

applicable_scope: RTX 3060, FP32, disk banks, synchronous CUDA tiles: geometry and density design slabs on 800 x 32 x 32 cells whose full diagonal epsilon exceeds the declared GPU budget; the optimizer-moment budget checks on CPU metadata for the dense, geometry and density paths re-recorded on 2c5f3754c047 for the release candidate.
verification_reason: no failures or errors, and no required test skipped or absent
